# Book of Giants Fragment 12 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 4Q532 frag. 2 (Cave 4) | **Condition:** extremely fragmentary; only isolated words and phrases survive

---

**12:1** [...] in the days of [...] the word of [...] the judgment of God [...]

**12:2** [...] came upon all the inhabitants of the earth [...]

**12:3** [...] for the wickedness was great [...]

**12:4** [...] and the corruption was complete [...]

**12:5** [...] and all the earth was filled with violence [...]

**12:6** [...] and all flesh [...] was destroyed [...] except [...]

**12:7** [...] those whom God preserved [...]

**12:8** [...] according to His mercy [...]

**12:9** [...] and the righteous ones [...] were saved [...]

**12:10** [...] from the destruction [...]

**12:11** [...] and the earth [...] was purified [...] from [...] corruption [...]

**12:12** [...] and from all the defilement [...]

**12:13** [...] which the Watchers and their sons had brought upon it [...]

**12:14** [...] and the earth was renewed [...]

**12:15** [...] and righteousness grew up upon it [...]

---

*LOGOS notes: Fragment 12 (Final Fragments). Source: 4Q532 frag. 2. The LOGOS translation renders the Aramaic into dignified formal English, preserving the literary register of the original without the mechanical hyphenation of EMET. Key theological terms and Semitic idioms are translated with established English equivalents. Square brackets mark genuine lacunae in the fragmentary manuscripts from Qumran Cave 4.*
